stories.title: Person found dead after fire at Aurora home
stories.summary: Neighbors called 911 to report the fire on East Gunnison Place shortly before 11 p.m. Tuesday.

stories.title: How to watch the 9NEWS Parade of Lights
stories.summary: Experience the magic of the 52nd 9NEWS Parade of Lights in downtown Denver on Saturday, Dec. 5, featuring floats, balloons, bands and Santa Claus.

stories.title: Eastbound I-70 reopens after SUV and semi truck crash near Frisco
stories.summary: Eastbound I-70 in Colorado's mountains reopened after an SUV lost control and collided with a semi truck, CSP said. One person was hospitalized.

stories.title: Cynthia Erivo to host Christmas tree lighting ceremony at Rockefeller Center on 9NEWS
stories.summary: The tradition of the Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree lighting returns on Dec. 2, featuring a star-studded lineup and festive performances.

stories.title: Help combat hunger: Donate to 9Cares Colorado Shares to support local food banks
stories.summary: The 9Cares Colorado Shares food drive supports five food banks, providing meals to struggling families. One in eight Coloradans face food insecurity.

stories.title: Fire danger in Colorado: Gusty winds, dry conditions on the Front Range
stories.summary: Gusty winds and a Red Flag Warning highlight Wednesday's elevated fire danger along Colorado's Front Range. Mountain snow showers continue into Thursday.

stories.title: Celtics vs. Nuggets showdown: Catch the action for free on KTVD
stories.summary: The Boston Celtics look to extend their four-game road winning streak against the Denver Nuggets, who have struggled at home.

stories.title: US 85 reopens after crash near Brighton
stories.summary: The Colorado Department of Transportation said southbound U.S. 85 was closed between E-470 and East 124th Avenue, in Brighton.

stories.title: Windy Wednesday, with elevated fire danger west of Denver
stories.summary: Fast moving storm brings high winds and light mountain snow. The National Weather Service issues a High Wind Warning for the Front Range Mountains and Foothills.

stories.title: Paonia welcomes author Peter Heller home with sold-out screening of 'The Dog Stars'
stories.summary: Author Peter Heller joined a sold-out Paonia screening of “The Dog Stars,” the Ridley Scott film inspired by his novel set partly in the Colorado town.

stories.title: 'Gategate': Bow Mar hits 'hard pause' on gate construction following Denver, Littleton lawsuit
stories.summary: A town spokesperson told 9NEWS on Tuesday that the town is pausing its planned construction date because of the lawsuit.

stories.title: Man sentenced for fatal crash involving school bus carrying high school wrestling team
stories.summary: The crash killed 18-year-old Julio Vasquez-Gonzalez, and injured everyone on the school bus and passengers in Andrew Miller's SUV.
